project_overview.target_audience: Premium homeowners, villa owners, hotels in Saudi Arabia
project_overview.mood: Luxury, calm, premium, trustworthy, aquatic elegance
project_overview.tech_stack: React, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion (Use .js/.jsx extensions, not .tsx)

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight leading-tight font-medium
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl tracking-tight leading-snug font-medium

motion.scroll_reveal: Fade up with y: 20, opacity: 0, duration: 0.6, ease: easeOut
motion.water_shimmer: Continuous slow background gradient translation or abstract water image with slow pan
motion.pulse_cta: Continuous drop-shadow/ring pulse on WhatsApp button

components_and_sections.name: Header & Nav
components_and_sections.layout: Fixed, top-0, z-50, w-full, glassmorphism surface. py-4 px-6.
components_and_sections.elements: Brand Logo (Text/Icon), EN/AR Language Toggle, Get Quote CTA on desktop.

components_and_sections.name: Premium Hero
components_and_sections.layout: min-h-[85vh] relative flex flex-col justify-center items-center text-center px-6 pt-24 pb-12
components_and_sections.elements: Background image with bg-black/50 overlay for text contrast. Overline Badge ('Saudi Arabia's Premier Pool Experts' inside glass pill). H1 ('Pure Serenity, Expertly Maintained.'). Subtext. Dual CTAs (Solid Cyan 'Get Free Quote' & Outline 'WhatsApp Us'). Soft cyan radial glow behind text.

components_and_sections.name: Trust / Why Choose Us
components_and_sections.layout: Grid cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 mobile: px-6 py-12
components_and_sections.elements: 4 Stat/Trust Cards (Years of Expertise, Premium Clients, Fast Response, Saudi-Based). Deep navy solid card bg, 1px cyan border on hover, large number/icon typography.

components_and_sections.name: Services Overview
components_and_sections.layout: Grid cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6 px-6 py-16
components_and_sections.elements: 9 Cards: Pool Cleaning, Water Treatment, Filter Servicing, Tile Cleaning, Leak Inspection, Pump Maintenance, Pool Installation, Deep Cleaning, AMC Support. Lucide React Icons + Title + Short Desc. Glassmorphism styling.

components_and_sections.name: Featured Services Highlight
components_and_sections.layout: Stacked large cards with overlapping text boxes. min-h-[400px] per highlight.
components_and_sections.elements: High-res image filling the card, gradient overlay from bottom, large white text. Highlights: Maintenance & Installation.

components_and_sections.name: Process Timeline
components_and_sections.layout: Vertical line on left (logical start), staggered items on right. px-6 py-16.
components_and_sections.elements: 4 Steps: Share Pool Details -> Get Expert Inspection -> Receive Quote -> Enjoy a Clean Pool. Cyan dot indicators. Minimalist tech/luxury feel.

components_and_sections.name: Results (Before / After)
components_and_sections.layout: Image comparison slider or stacked cards.
components_and_sections.elements: Showcase clean pools using abstract water textures and luxury villa images.

components_and_sections.name: Testimonials
components_and_sections.layout: Single card carousel / horizontal snap scroll on mobile.
components_and_sections.elements: Gold/Cyan stars, Quote mark icon, Italic text, Client name (Villa/Hotel context).

components_and_sections.name: Contact / Quote Form
components_and_sections.layout: Form inside a glassmorphic card. Scroll target for 'Get Free Quote'.
components_and_sections.elements: Inputs for Name, Phone, Service Select, Message. Submit button (shows success toast using Sonner). Frontend only.

components_and_sections.name: Footer & Floating CTA
components_and_sections.layout: Dark minimal footer + Fixed bottom-right sticky button.
components_and_sections.elements: Footer: Logo, Contact placeholders (+966 XX XXX XXXX, info@alalampools.sa), location. Floating CTA: WhatsApp icon, green bg, continuous subtle pulse animation.

accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., 'lang-toggle', 'quote-form-submit', 'whatsapp-float-btn', 'service-card').
accessibility_and_testing.rtl_support: Use 'dir="rtl"' on the main container when Arabic is active. Use Tailwind logical properties (e.g., ms-4, pe-4, space-x-reverse, text-start) to ensure layouts flip correctly automatically without media query hacks.
